name: plate-rulebook
prompt: A close top-down view of a THICK old leather notebook lying open on a low wooden table under a warm desk lamp. Dark brown leather, worn corners, the spine cracked from use. The two open pages fill most of the frame. A pen rests in the gutter. **Every page and every screen must be COMPLETELY BLANK — pure empty paper, no writing, no printed lines, no letters, no numbers, no symbols, no smudges that look like text.** The text will be added afterwards by hand. Lofi anime art. IMPORTANT STYLE RULES: same overall BRIGHTNESS as the reference images, do NOT make this darker or more cinematic; same SATURATED blue-violet, lilac and cyan palette; same FLAT lofi-anime cel shading, minimal gradients, no depth-of-field, no bloom.
